record.kind: flag read by SoundCryEffect: triples the SOUND cry (scale 3) when the holder casts; no PassiveEffects entry
record.summary: Passive.MEGA_LAUNCHER has no PassiveEffects entry. Its only behavioural reference is in SoundCryEffect.apply (app/core/effects/synergies.ts): `const scale = pokemon.passive === Passive.MEGA_LAUNCHER ? 3 : 1`, where `pokemon` is the unit that just cast. SoundCryEffect is an OnAbilityCastEffect, run by castAbility after the ability's process(). CLAUNCHER and CLAWITZER are WATER + SOUND, so each gets a SoundCryEffect (a tiered one when LARGO / ALLEGRO / PRESTO is active, otherwise a tier-0 one). When such a holder casts WATER_PULSE, the effect walks the board and, for every unit of the holder's team (the holder included), calls addAttack(attackBuff x 3), addSpeed(speedBuff x 3) and addPP(ppGain x 3) with caster = the holder, apBoost 0, crit false, and adds 3 (instead of 1) to count.soundCryCount. Per-tier raw amounts: tier 0 (no SOUND tier) 0 / 0 / 0; LARGO 2 / 0 / 0; ALLEGRO 1 / 5 / 0; PRESTO 1 / 5 / 3 (attack / speed / PP), so the tripled raw values are 0, 6, 3 or 15 and 9 (LARGO attack 6; ALLEGRO attack 3, speed 15; PRESTO attack 3, speed 15, PP 9). Those are REQUESTED amounts: addAttack rounds, then applies Big Eater Belt (+25 percent rounded down on buffs) and Twist Band (no effect on positive values) and floors atk at 1; addSpeed applies the same two helpers, converts to attack x0.5 for a MELMETAL receiver and clamps to 0..MAX_SPEED; addPP rounds, halves positive gains on a fatigued receiver, is blocked for a positive value by silence, status.protect, the NO_PP_GAIN effect or resurrecting, and clamps to maxPP x 2 - 1 (Rune Protect alone blocks nothing). The tripling applies only when the caster is the MEGA_LAUNCHER holder; other SOUND casters still use scale 1 and Clauncher / Clawitzer receiving someone else's cry get the ordinary single amount. Not tripled: the adjacent Chimecho +3 PP (fixed, once per cast) and the +5 AP of a sleeping Comatose ally.
triggers: Holder finishes casting its ability (castAbility -> OnAbilityCastEffect.apply -> SoundCryEffect.apply); requires the holder to carry a SoundCryEffect, which every SOUND-type unit receives
